intent: Approved H2 frost glass and Y1 concealed amber illumination for production.

variants.title: H2 — huurrelasi
variants.detail: WINTER VARIANT B: cold glass with subtle misty condensation restricted to the outermost 10 percent of the glass circumference, an irregular milky edge fading smoothly inward, a few tiny frozen droplets along the lower rim. Slightly silvered cool glass reflection. The center 80 percent of the dial stays completely clear and black. No branches, no fern crystals, no snow wreath, no spikes. A simple natural cold-window effect rather than decorative ice.
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready blank circular instrument face sprite for the painted WWI biplane game Rainbow Patrol. Image 1 is STYLE/MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: match the existing aged brass instrument at the upper middle of the atlas, but create a new single isolated face. Front orthographic view, perfectly circular, concentric, centered at (512,512), outer diameter about 900px on a square 1024x1024 canvas. Dark almost-black charcoal enamel dial, worn narrow brass rim and four small countersunk slotted mounting screws. Fine painted game sprite detail, warm aged metal, restrained glass reflections. Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO scale marks, NO needles, NO central hub; the game will draw its real values and hands separately. Blank dial center must remain dark, clean and readable. NO extra objects. Fully transparent background outside the circular instrument, clean genuine alpha. Keep whole circle within the canvas with 50px transparent margin. Not a full dashboard, no rectangular panel. Slightly silvered cool glass reflection. The center 80 percent of the dial stays completely clear and black. No branches, no fern crystals, no snow wreath, no spikes. A simple natural cold-window effect rather than decorative ice.

variants.title: Y1 — piilotettu meripihkavalo
variants.detail: NIGHT VARIANT A: believable subdued amber instrument illumination from an INVISIBLE recessed source behind the upper INNER bezel lip. A very thin warm reflected light along the inside rim gently illuminates the dark glass, with lower half remaining dark. NO visible lightbulbs, no miniature desk lamps, no domes, no protruding housings, no bright points, no futuristic neon ring. Concealed warm light, practical low-light cockpit readability. Brass outer rim remains dim brown.
